68 English Grammar and Composition
Introductory
‘There’ & ‘It’
Read the following text and notice the use of introductory ‘There’ and ‘It’:
| am a student of class six. | go to Magura Govt. High School. It’s an old school
and quite famous. There’s a big open field in front of our school. There’s a large

subject: English_grammar
text:
ond at the back of the school too. There’re one thousand students and 50
teachers in our school. We are proud of our school. It’s 11 o’clock now. It’s time
for our 1* period. It’s a clear sunny day after two rainy days. | feel wonderful
today.

subject: English_grammar
text:
We’ve our school uniform. It’s a white shirt with white trousers. Teachers do
not allow students to enter classes without uniform. It’s good that teachers are
strict on this point. A few days ago, there was an accident on our way to school.
One of our students was knocked down by a rickshaw. Nobody knew the name

subject: English_grammar
text:
of the boy. But the boy had school uniform. So, it was not hard for people to
contact the school.
How do the underlined sentences begin?
Use
1. We use there to say that something exists.
e.g. There is a big open field in front of our school.
2. We can use there to talk about things that happen and situations.
e.g. There was an accident on our way to school.

subject: English_grammar
text:
3. We can use there for a number of people and things.
e.g. There are one thousand students and 50 teachers in our school.
4. We use it to give time, day, month, date, etc.
e.g. It’s 11 o’clock now.
5. We use it to describe someone’s situation.
e.g. So it was not hard for people to contact the school.
6. We use it to talk about weather.
e.g. It’s a clear sunny day.

English Grammar and Composition 69
Activity 1
Angshu is visiting Kuakata. He writes a mail to one of his best friends Adrita.
In the mail both introductory ‘there’ and ‘it’ have been used. Read the mail
and circle the correct words.
Dear Adrita

subject: English_grammar
text:
Greetings from Kuakata.There’s/It’s really good to be here and I’m enjoying
myself. There’s/It’s a good time of year to come to this place because
there’s/it’s not tourists crowded now. They say, there are/It’s a lot many places
to explore here. But there’s/it’s not possible on my part to see everything. You
know, I’m here only for a few days. There’s/It’s 2 o’clock in the afternoon now.
I’m sitting before the sea under a huge colorful umbrella. There’s/It’s breezing
now. No words can describe my feeling. There are/It’s some pine trees at my
back. | can hear some birds chirping from there. | can hear the roaring of the
sea. There are/It'S some boats fishing in the sea. Everything is very calm and
quiet. There’s/It’s lunch time now. So I’m planning to go to a local restaurant.
The fish curry is wonderful in these restaurants as everything is so fresh.

subject: English_grammar
text:
There’s/It’s a fantastic place, Adrita. Do visit here next time.
Best Regards,
Angshu

decide whether the underlined words are correctly used. If yes, put a tick
mark beside the gaps. If not, write the correct word in the gaps. The first one
is done for you.
Mr Editor

subject: English_grammar

| live in a densely populated area. There are v_a few families living here. There
are some student’s messes too. Often the young kids play badminton and

and _ there’s impossible to have a calm and quiet time at home.
It’s many students in the area. It’s difficult for them to
concentrate on their studies. There’s quite natural that young boys
and girls will play. But is it acceptable that they will play until midnight with the
cost of others’ disturbance? Moreover, there are parties in the

volume music. Besides its screams, and shouts! ..... And believe me
